scope: International Melbourne Cup nominees: first-shipment arrival status reverified after first acceptances
policy: Preserve only explicitly published campaign/travel facts. Arrival is promoted only where a dated public source explicitly states the horse is already in Australia or arrived in Melbourne. No rating is inferred.
quarantine: Do not infer exact arrival timestamps where sources only say arrived over the weekend/already in Australia.
Do not infer any R&S, Timeform, official or other rating from travel/campaign reporting.
Second-shipment horses remain awaiting travel unless a later dated public source confirms arrival.
